mapper.sql: t.id, t.user_id, t.template_id, tpl.title AS template_title, tpl.cover_url AS template_cover_url, t.status, t.current_stage, t.failure_stage, t.failure_reason, t.result_path, t.sim_asset_check_ms, t.sim_generate_ms, t.sim_result_ms, t.sim_fail_stage, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.started_at, t.finished_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (id, user_id, template_id, status, sim_asset_check_ms, sim_generate_ms, sim_result_ms, sim_fail_stage, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{status}, #{simAssetCheckMs}, #{simGenerateMs}, #{simResultMs}, #{simFailStage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO task_asset (task_id, sort_index, asset_id) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{sortIndex}, #{assetId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task t JOIN template tpl ON tpl.id = t.template_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.id IN #{id}
SELECT id FROM task WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = 'PROCESSING', started_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE task SET current_stage = #{stage}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', current_stage = NULL, result_path = #{resultPath}, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE task SET status = 'FAILED', current_stage = NULL, failure_stage = #{stage}, failure_reason = #{reason}, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE task SET status = 'FAILED', failure_stage = current_stage, current_stage = NULL, failure_reason = #{reason}, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_stage_run (task_id, stage, status, started_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{stage}, 'RUNNING', #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE task_stage_run SET status = #{status}, message = #{message}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND stage = #{stage}
mapper.select: SELECT stage, status, message, started_at, finished_at FROM task_stage_run WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY started_at, stage
